note: reject_before drops a middle initial after a name (`Michael R. at 5`), a capitalized abbreviation (`Fed. R.`, `12 Pitts. R. at 345`), and other reporter short forms (`12 Pac.R. at 345`, `12 R. at 345`); `See R. at 5` and `found. R. at 5` still match. Merged with us.record.record_at (retired); a capitalized word before `R.` is read as a name, so `Compare R. at 3` is not detected (`Compare (R. at 3)` is).
